# #4037: Patch: remove the "How JackiOh uses AI" page (/ai)
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What

The owner wants the public **How JackiOh uses AI** page, `/ai` (https://staging.jackioh.com/ai), removed from the site. It was added in #2631 under **R2631000**. Take it out completely: the route, its footer link, its title, its sitemap and static-page entries, its tests, and the docs that describe it.

**CLAUDE.md rule 13:** `/ai` is a public route that people can visit. A person asked for this removal directly, so the bot does not need to stop and ask.

## Where it lives (from a grep of `main`)

- `apps/web/src/routes/ai.tsx`: the page. Delete it.
- `apps/web/src/routes/ai.test.tsx`: its tests, which prove R2631000. Delete it.
- `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts:241-242`: `paths.ai`.
- `apps/web/src/main.tsx:747`: the route dispatch, `if (path === paths.ai) return <AiRoute />`.
- `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx:78`: the lazy chunk `ai: routeChunk(...)`.
- `apps/web/src/net/head.ts:35`: the document title, "How JackiOh uses AI".
- `apps/web/src/routes/SiteFooter.tsx`: the "AI use" footer link (around line 59), `siteFooterTestid.ai`, and the header comment's mention of the page.
- `apps/web/static-pages.ts`: the sitemap entry (around line 62) and the quoted page text (around line 218).
- Tests that list the page: `apps/web/src/static-pages.test.ts` (lines 45 and 365), `apps/web/src/routes/page-names.test.tsx:31`, `apps/web/src/routes/engine-gate.test.tsx:149`, and `e2e/cypress/e2e/38-accessibility.cy.ts` (lines 67 and 216-217).
- `docs/compliance.md` §9, "How JackiOh uses AI (R2631000)". Remove the section or rewrite it so it no longer points at a page that is gone. Check whether any other section refers to it.
- `assets/voice/SOURCES.md:3` cites #2631 and R2631000. The voice-sources record stays. Only reword the line if it mentions the page itself.
- Nothing else should reference `AI_LAST_UPDATED` or `MUSIC_SOURCES_URL` once `ai.tsx` is gone. Delete them, and move them only if something outside the page still reads them.

Do not touch `@jackioh/ai`, `wire/ai.ts` or the practice AI. They share the name but have nothing to do with this page.

## The ruling

R2631000's proving test goes away along with the page, so `cargo jackioh spec check` will fail until the ruling is handled. Record the removal as a new ruling in this issue's block, numbered by CLAUDE.md rule 3. It should say that the owner asked for `/ai` to be removed, and it should amend or withdraw R2631000 the same way other amended rulings are handled (see R2756000's title, "amended by …"). Put its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<N>.md`. Back it with a proving test, for example a web test that `/ai` is no longer in the footer, the sitemap or `static-pages.ts`, and that the path falls through to whatever the router does for any unknown path. Fix any other R-id citations that `spec check` flags.

## Acceptance

- `/ai` no longer renders the page. It behaves like any other unknown path.
- The site footer has no "AI use" link. `/ai` is in neither the sitemap nor `static-pages.ts`.
- `docs/compliance.md` no longer describes the page.
- These pass: `cargo jackioh spec check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`, and the e2e accessibility spec (`38-accessibility.cy.ts`).
- The change ships no card data, so no patch fragment should be needed. Confirm this with `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`.
